page_title: CHE 3-2 NEW | Chelsea v Newcastle 11/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' John Brooks shows a yellow card to Joe White (Newcastle Utd) for his blatant foul.
90+5' The game is interrupted. Cesare Casadei (Chelsea) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
90+3' Great teamplay by Newcastle as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
90+1' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Nicolas Jackson walks off the pitch to be replaced by Carney Chukwuemeka (Chelsea).
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' 3 - 2 Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) blasts the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box and it flies straight into the top right corner of the net!
89' The Chelsea players are exchanging some short passes.
86' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Newcastle comes to nothing.
86' Substitution. Cole Palmer walks off the pitch and Cesare Casadei (Chelsea) comes on as a substitute.
81' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and John Brooks blows for a foul.
81' Eddie Howe has decided to make a change. Joe White (Newcastle Utd) replaces Bruno Guimaraes.
80' A substitution has been made. Joe Willock goes off and Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) comes on.
80' Elliot Anderson (Newcastle Utd) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
80' The Chelsea players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
76' 3 - 1 Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Martin Dubravka with a low strike into the middle of the goal. He makes it 3:1.
74' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Djordje Petrovic intercepts the ball.
74' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
72' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) is booked after bringing down an opponent. John Brooks had an easy-decision to make.
71' Djordje Petrovic (Chelsea) receives a harsh yellow card from the referee after committing a minor foul on his opponent.
71' Here's the change. Raheem Sterling leaves the pitch and Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) comes on as a substitute.
70' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
69' Eddie Howe has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Emil Krafth (Newcastle Utd) replacing Dan Burn.
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Elliot Anderson (Newcastle Utd) is coming onto the pitch as Miguel Almiron cannot continue after picking up an injury.

68' What an opportunity! Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the resulting free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
68' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul. Newcastle are awarded a free kick.
67' Shots on target – 6:2.
63' Newcastle enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
61' John Brooks blows for a foul after Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.

60' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.

60' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) bursts into the box and pulls the trigger, but he can't beat the goalkeeper. He directed his shot towards the middle of the goal, but one of the defenders reacted brilliantly to block it.
58' 2 - 1 Cole Palmer (Chelsea) scores! He latches on to a pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box. The ball goes inside the right post and past the goalkeeper.
57' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
56' Dangerous play by Sven Botman (Newcastle Utd). John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul.
55' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
52' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
49' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee John Brooks saw the whole situation.
49' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
48' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

48' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd), whose effort would probably have ended in the roof of the net. The ball is out of play and Newcastle manage to earn a corner.
46' John Brooks blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' The ball falls to Raheem Sterling (Chelsea), but his shot towards the middle of the goal is weak and Martin Dubravka makes an easy save.
45+5' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
45+4' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
45+1' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) has a goal ruled out for offside!
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
43' 1 - 1 Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) doesn't hesitate to lash home from just outside the box. He hits the ball precisely into the bottom right corner and it nestles in the net.

40' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) plants a header from the edge of the box after a nice cross from the free kick. It lacks accuracy and the ball flies way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
39' Yellow card. Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
38' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) latches onto a brilliant cross and fires the ball towards goal, but his shot goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
36' Eddie Howe is forced to make a change. Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Jacob Murphy.
35' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
34' John Brooks blows his whistle. Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) commits a foul after dangerous play.
33' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
32' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Newcastle can continue in their attacking effort.
32' John Brooks couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) and blew his whistle.
30' The number of shots on goal at present is 3:0.
29' The ball is cleared after Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.
28' The Newcastle players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
26' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
25' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left John Brooks no option but to blow his whistle.
24' John Brooks interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Cole Palmer (Chelsea).
23' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
21' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Martin Dubravka was alert and made a comfortable save.
18' John Brooks has a clear sight and sees a foul from Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd).
18' Chelsea control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
16' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) is able to continue to play.
16' Looks like Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

13' That didn't go as planned! Cole Palmer (Chelsea) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom right corner was too weak to get past Martin Dubravka, who easily kept it out.
12' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
11' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
6' 1 - 0 Goal! Cole Palmer takes aim and his effort deflects off Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) to beat the goalkeeper. 1:0.
5' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
4' Newcastle are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
2' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Chelsea will have the kick-off.
John Brooks is the one to supervise the game today.
